cand.question: Can Katz middle convolution on rigid local systems over P^1 \ {0, 1, infty} construct a single motivic Galois representation unifying all signatures (p, q, r) >= 3?
cand.context: Katz middle convolution MC_chi produces irreducible local systems from hypergeometric data, but Katz rigidity index depends on the local monodromy conjugacy classes which vary with (p, q, r).
